objective: Learn which truthful CAI value proposition produces qualified interest from CUAI readers.

variants.headline: AI training should move as fast as AI does.
Prepare your credit union for what changed in AI this week.

measurement.viewableImpression: At least 50 percent of the banner is visible.
measurement.unsupportedBrowserRule: When viewability cannot be established because IntersectionObserver is unavailable, omit the impression; clicks still record.

decisionRule.qualifiedSignalRequired: At least one independently observed CAI intent event or lead from the winning variant.
decisionRule.inconclusive: Continue to 250 viewable impressions per variant, then retain the clearer message if no winner emerges.

stopConditions: The destination is unavailable or materially misleading.
The message implies delivery that CAI cannot verify.
The placement causes editorial confusion or a material accessibility or performance regression.
claimBoundary: This experiment promotes current training and readiness. It does not claim that CAI presently awards a verified formal certification.
governance: Internal verification traffic is excluded from customer conclusions. CUAI editorial coverage remains independent from CAI promotion.
